verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Stripe Atlas handles incorporation, EIN, 83(b) elections, and tax filing as a human-facing dashboard/paperwork service with lawyer/accountant support, but there is no evidence of any agent-accessible API, delegation mechanism, or AI-agent workflow for compliance filings; community notes even highlight ongoing manual legwork and need for accountants/lawyers. Missing for 10: any API/agent interface for filings, evidence of autonomous or minimal-human-input agent delegation, documentation of an agent-facing workflow for annual reports or compliance filings.
